name: 断层（性质/位移/活动性）判定

map.按断层位移量与活动年限估算年均位移速率，判定活动性等级与工程风险。: Estimate the annual displacement rate from the fault displacement and active period, and determine the activity grade and engineering risk.
map.年均位移 = 位移量 ÷ 活动年限；≥0.01 mm/年 活动断层、≥0.001: Annual displacement = displacement ÷ active period; ≥0.01 mm/year active fault, ≥0.001 suspected, otherwise stable
map.断层活动性以位移量与时间换算速率：年均位移=位移量(mm)÷活动年限(年)。≥0: Fault activity is the rate converted from displacement and time: annual displacement = displacement (mm) ÷ active period (years). ≥0.01 mm/year is an active fault, ≥0.001 suspected active, otherwise stable. Active faults carry high engineering risk, and site selection and seismic design must be raised in grade.
map.💡 年均位移 = 位移量 ÷ 活动年限；≥0.01 活动、≥0.001 疑似、否: 💡 Annual displacement = displacement ÷ active period; ≥0.01 active, ≥0.001 suspected, otherwise stable.
map.📚 深度解析：断层性质与活动性野外判别（正/逆/走滑·活动分级）: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Field Identification of Fault Nature and Activity (Normal/Reverse/Strike-slip · Activity Grading)
map.性质判别：依据断层面擦痕侧伏向、阶步与两盘相对位移方向判定正断层/逆断层/走滑断: Nature identification: determine a normal/reverse/strike-slip fault from the pitch of slickensides on the fault plane, the steps and the relative displacement of the two blocks
map.活动性评估：结合错断最新地层、断崖新鲜度与探槽位错量，判活动/非活动: Activity assessment: judge active/inactive from the latest offset strata, the freshness of the fault scarp and the trench displacement
map.工程避让：为线路工程与建筑场地提供断层避让距离与抗震设防建议: Engineering avoidance: provide fault avoidance distances and seismic design advice for linear projects and building sites
map.判别要点：擦痕侧伏角近水平（<15°）→走滑断层；近垂直（>75°）且上盘上升→: Key points: a slickenside pitch near horizontal (<15°) → strike-slip fault; near vertical (>75°) with the hanging wall rising → reverse fault; hanging wall falling → normal fault. The scarp of the steps (feather-tension fractures) points in the movement direction of the opposite block. Activity is graded by the age of the offset strata, the scarp height and the displacement rate (local reference; combine with measured sections).
map.例：某走滑断层擦痕侧伏角 10°、水平错距 50m，错断的全新统地层厚 8m →: Example: a strike-slip fault with a slickenside pitch of 10° and a horizontal offset of 50 m, offsetting Holocene strata 8 m thick → strike-slip in nature, active since the Late Pleistocene; the horizontal slip rate is about 50 m/(8×10³ a)≈6.25 mm/a, so an engineering avoidance zone of ≥30 m and higher seismic design are recommended.
map.擦痕被破坏怎么判别性质？: How do you judge the nature if the slickensides are destroyed?
map.可改用阶步、构造岩分带（碎裂岩→糜棱岩）与两盘地层重复/缺失关系综合判定。单一标: Use the steps, the tectonite zonation (cataclasite → mylonite) and the repetition/missing relationship of the strata on the two blocks to judge comprehensively. When a single marker is unreliable, dig trenches or shallow boreholes for direct displacement evidence.
map.活动性分级依据什么？: What is the activity grading based on?
map.主要看错断的最新地质体时代：错断全新统为活动断层，错断上更新统为晚更新世活动，更: Mainly the age of the latest offset geological body: offsetting Holocene strata is an active fault, offsetting Upper Pleistocene is Late Pleistocene activity, and older is inactive. The exact thresholds follow engineering site fault-activity assessment codes such as GB/T 36072.
